BISBCZR Index.name: Czech Republic Real Effective
BISBCZR Index.des_notes: An effective exchange rate (also known as a trade-weighted exchange rate) is a weighted average of the individual exchange rates of a particular country with its main trading partners. The bilateral exchange rates are weighted according to the importance of each partner country's share of trade with the reporting country. The real effective exchange rate (REER) is adjusted for inflation.

BREERCZK Index.name: Bloomberg Intelligence REER In
BREERCZK Index.des_notes:
The Bloomberg-calculated ticker shows the real effective exchange rate (REER) of an economy relative to its top 15 main trading partners. The REER series are based on Bloomberg Intelligence's nominal effective exchange rate (NEER) calculations ALLX NEER .
They adjust the NEER for changes in relative price levels to capture movements in international price competitiveness. The weightings are dynamic and based on each trading partner's rolling 3-year trade shares. Numbers are subject to revisions if underlying trade or price data are corrected.
